context_for_next_testing_agent: BlocksPreventedCard is now mounted in Guard Shadow tab between Per-Patent Enforcement and Filters sections. The card reads from /api/admin/blocks-prevented/summary which aggregates EXECUTION_REJECTED proof blocks. Auto-promotion suggestions appear when a flag is in shadow mode with <5% would-block rate over 7d and >=50 evaluations. Currently all flags are enforcing so no suggestions are displayed. The tzinfo bug fix in admin_guard_shadow.py line ~298 ensures Mongo datetime round-trips don't crash the oldest-row subtraction.
